name: grade-6-math
description: Use ratios, expressions and area models.

interface.longDescription: Use ratios, expressions and area models. Includes a launch screen, side-panel workspace, editable input controls and real computations: Scale a ratio; Evaluate ax + b; Find triangle area. Imports and exports its own versioned documents. Uses supplied information; no live lookup or background monitoring.

positive.description: Open the launch screen without calculating.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the actual launch screen with three distinct workflow cards. No computation or file access.

positive.prompt: Open the Number Steps: Grade 6 Math workspace beside this chat.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the editable workspace and labeled illustrative inputs. No computation starts automatically.

positive.prompt: Help me scale a ratio with these supplied values: {"left":3,"right":5,"multipliers":[1,2,3,4]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses grade_6_math_ratio_table with the supplied inputs. Returns {"unit_rate":1.6667,"rows":[{"multiplier":1,"left":3,"right":5},{"multiplier":2,"left":6,"right":10},{"multiplier":3,"left":9,"right":15},{"multiplier":4,"left":12,"right":20}]}. Shows the actual ratio result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.prompt: Help me evaluate ax + b with these supplied values: {"coefficient":4,"x":7,"constant":3}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses grade_6_math_evaluate_expression with the supplied inputs. Returns {"product":28,"answer":31,"substitution":"(4) × (7) + (3)"}. Shows the actual equation result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.prompt: Help me find triangle area with these supplied values: {"base":12,"height":7}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses grade_6_math_triangle_area with the supplied inputs. Returns {"base":12,"height":7,"rectangle_area":84,"area":42,"formula":"A = base × perpendicular height ÷ 2"}. Shows the actual triangle result. Does not fabricate external data.
